def: A short document written in advance that says which action to take when a given trigger occurs, and who or what takes it.
A means of ending a run at once that sits outside the loop's write boundary, acts below the agent, fails safe and preserves evidence.
A fail-safe in which the run continues only while a regular heartbeat arrives, so the loss of the watcher halts it.
A hard ceiling, enforced outside the loop, on something the run consumes such as dollars, tokens, GPU hours or time.
A ceiling on consumption per unit time, which reacts to fast growth sooner than a cap on the total.
A process outside the sandbox that tracks spend, denials and heartbeats and halts the run when a rule trips.
Returning a run to a trusted checkpoint by appending a rollback entry, so the earlier entries stay as evidence.
A saved state of the run store that can be returned to if later entries prove tainted.
Telling the owners of an affected system, then the public, what was found, with a timeline and the controls that failed.
A review that explains what happened and which controls failed without assigning fault to a person.
